subject: Next steps: buyer map, procurement path & SOC2 evidence schedule (Greenlight Health)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@greenlighthealth.com>; Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenlighthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: buyer map, procurement path & SOC2 evidence schedule (Greenlight Health)

Hi Mike / Emily —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Decision criteria we heard: inference latency < 200ms for median 1k RPS, predictable per-token cost for budgeting, SOC2 Type II + pen test evidence for security review, and audit-log availability for a 90-day retention window.
- Stakeholders: Mike (product lead / technical sponsor), Emily (security), Procurement (TBD, will assign contact), and an economic buyer (you mentioned CFO or Head of Cloud spend).

Action items (proposed timeline):
1) We will deliver SOC2 Type II summary, pen test executive summary, and a short Q&A on data retention by EOD next week (Feb 27). (Owner: me)
2) Please confirm procurement contact and whether a third-party procurement portal is required.
3) If you can share the name/email of the economic buyer, we’ll prepare a short TCO slide tailored to your current monthly tokens and RPS.

Attachments: I’ll follow up with evidence docs in a separate email to make the procurement handoff cleaner.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@greenlighthealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenlighthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: buyer map, procurement path & SOC2 evidence schedule (Greenlight Health)

Thanks Olga — this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: looping in Aaron Cole from our procurement partner (ProcureTech); Aaron will advise on PO vs contract and whether we need to go through our S2P portal. I’ll forward his details separately, but cc'ing him in a follow-up.
- Economic buyer: our CFO is Lina Marques (lina.marques@greenlighthealth.com). She wants a 2-slide TCO that compares current cloud-hosted model spend vs an optimized inference plan.
- Evidence: Emily will own security review; Emily, quick question — will the SOC2 summary + pen test exec summary be sufficient to clear the first gate, or should we expect a deeper questionnaire?

Happy to book a follow-up once you send the evidence.

—Mike
Product Director | Greenlight Health

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenlighthealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>; Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@greenlighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: buyer map, procurement path & SOC2 evidence schedule (Greenlight Health)

Hi Olga —

SOC2 summary and pen test exec summary are a good start for the security team to triage. We will likely follow up with a short questionnaire focused on: data flow diagrams, encryption (in transit & at rest), key management, multi-tenant isolation details, and audit-log retention/format. Audit-log sample extract (CSV) is very helpful.

Also: we need confirmation that any PII stored for model optimization can be configured to be excluded and that we can set a 90-day auto-delete window. If you can include a brief statement about retention controls and the location(s) of logs, that speeds our review.

Thanks,
Emily
Security Lead | Greenlight Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: buyer map & prep for procurement handoff (Greenlight Health)

Folks — quick internal note to map the buying committee before we send evidence: 

- Technical sponsor: Mike Jensen (Product) — will validate latency and integration effort.
- Security: Emily Zhao — will own SOC2/pen-test review + retention Qs.
- Procurement: Aaron Cole / Greenlight Procurement (will confirm portal).
- Economic buyer: Lina Marques (CFO) — needs concise TCO (2 slides).
- Implementation lead (post-sale): recommend we pre-assign Marcus as the SE for technical scoping once we get legal/procurement signals.

Ask: Olga — can you confirm the go/no-go criteria Lina will use (hours saved? cost savings threshold?) If we don’t know, propose 2 TCO scenarios (conservative / aggressive) and I’ll draft slides.

Also prepping a single ZIP with the required evidence docs so procurement has one download. Marcus, can you validate the audit-log extract format (CSV) — we should include column definitions.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@greenlighthealth.com>; Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenlighthealth.com>; Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@procuretech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence package and proposed timeline (Greenlight Health)

Hi Mike / Emily / Aaron —

Attached is the evidence package we discussed: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf, pen-test-executive-summary.pdf, and retention_policy_qna.docx. I also included a small audit-log sample (audit-log-sample-extract.csv) with column definitions in the doc. 

Proposed timeline:
- Security triage: 3 business days to confirm if follow-up questionnaire is required. (Emily)
- Procurement review: 5 business days for initial SOW/PO guidance. (Aaron)
- CFO TCO slides: we’ll send draft 2-slide TCO by Mar 2 (Owner: Lauren).

If anything missing for procurement (contracts, insurance certs, tax forms), tell us and we’ll expedite.

Attachments: 
- redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (SOC2 Type II scope & auditor contact)
- pen-test-executive-summary.pdf (high-level findings, no PII)
- retention_policy_qna.docx (answers about retention controls and configurable deletion)
- audit-log-sample-extract.csv (sample format)

Best,
Olga

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenlighthealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>; Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@procuretech.com>
Cc: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@greenlighthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence package and proposed timeline (Greenlight Health)

Olga — received, thanks. We pulled the SOC2 summary and pen-test exec summary into our tracker. A couple quick asks: 

1) Can you provide an audit-log sample that includes request_id, timestamp (UTC), model_variant, user_id (hashed), and response_size_bytes? The attached CSV is helpful but missing model_variant column.
2) For the retention_policy_qna.docx, please add an explicit confirmation that auto-delete can be configured per-customer to 90 days and that KMS keys are customer-segregated in Private deployments.

If you can send those two items by EOD Monday we should be able to close the security gate for a preliminary risk sign-off.

—Emily

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: status update — Greenlight evidence sent, awaiting audit-log + retention confirmation

Quick update for the thread: 
- Evidence package sent to security + procurement (see thread).
- Emily asked for an expanded audit-log sample including model_variant + explicit retention/KMS statement.
- Lauren preparing TCO slides for Lina; target Mar 2 delivery.
- Next internal milestone: confirm we can produce the revised audit-log CSV and retention wording by EOD Monday (Owner: Marcus to produce CSV; Owner: Monica to confirm KMS wording).

I’ll draft the reply to Emily and attach the revised CSV once Marcus confirms format.

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
